# Samploon

> > Samploon is a free essay sample repository providing academic writing examples across social sciences, history, healthcare, education, and cultural studies.

The platform offers model essays covering topics from body image and mental health to historical events like the Philippine Revolution and EDSA People Power Revolution, standardized testing debates, nursing practice, and socioeconomic systems. Essays reference key scholars and frameworks including Mona Baker's translation theory, Gibbs' Reflective Cycle, and analyses of figures like Ferdinand Marcos and George Monbiot.

## Key Topics

- Essay samples and academic writing
- Body image and eating disorders
- Mental health and self-esteem
- Philippine Revolution and EDSA People Power Revolution
- Ferdinand Marcos and Philippine history
- Standardized testing and student learning
- Nursing practice and healthcare
- Capitalism and economic systems
- Cultural competence and Indian culture
- World War I and World War II history
- Translation theory and Mona Baker
- Gender differences and bias
- Drug abuse and addiction recovery
- Professionalism and workplace communication
- Capital punishment debate

## Health and Psychology Essays

- [Body Image is How People see Themselves](https://samploon.com/body-image-is-how-people-see-themselves): Essay on body image, self-esteem, and eating disorders impact
- [Memory and Brain Process](https://samploon.com/memory-and-brain-process): Essay on memory types, brain function, and cognitive psychology basics
- [Recovery's Long Road: Drug Abuse](https://samploon.com/recoverys-long-road-drug-abuse): Essay on teen drug abuse, addiction causes, and recovery pathways
- [Decision-Making Process of Men and Women](https://samploon.com/decision-making-process-of-men-and-women): Research essay on gender differences in decision-making processes

## Nursing and Healthcare Essays

- [Importance of Critical Reflection for Nurses](https://samploon.com/importance-of-critical-reflection-for-nurses): Nursing essay on reflective practice using Gibbs' Reflective Cycle
- [Cultural Assessment of Indian Culture](https://samploon.com/cultural-assessment-of-indian-culture): Nursing essay on cultural competence in Indian healthcare contexts
- [Work Related Stress](https://samploon.com/work-related-stress): Essay on nursing stress & burnout in Saudi Arabia healthcare workers

## History and Political Science Essays

- [Benefits and Harm of Capitalism](https://samploon.com/benefits-and-harm-of-capitalism): Essay analyzing capitalism through Philippine Revolution & EDSA events
- [Impact Of World War Two On Australia](https://samploon.com/impact-of-world-war-two-on-australia): Essay on WWII's social & political impact on Australian society
- [The Reconstruction Time - Time of Enormous Political Multifaceted Nature](https://samploon.com/the-reconstruction-time-time-of-enormous-political-multifaceted-nature): Essay on Reconstruction Era, African American history, and Black Codes
- [History Of The Great War](https://samploon.com/history-of-the-great-war): Essay on WWI causes, alliances, and Archduke Franz Ferdinand assassination

## Education and Learning Essays

- [Does Standardized Testing Enhance Student Learning?](https://samploon.com/does-standardized-testing-enhance-student-learning): Essay examining standardized testing impact on student learning
- [Why Is a College Education Important?](https://samploon.com/why-is-a-college-education-important): Essay on benefits of college education for career development
- [Communication with Children](https://samploon.com/communication-with-children): Essay on age-appropriate communication strategies in education settings

## Social Issues and Ethics Essays

- [Support of Capital Punishment](https://samploon.com/support-of-capital-punishment): Essay examining death penalty debate, deterrence, and rehabilitation
- [Prejudice in the Game Hub](https://samploon.com/prejudice-in-the-game-hub): Essay on gender bias and racial stereotypes in gaming industry
- [What is Professionalism?](https://samploon.com/what-is-professionalism): Essay on workplace professionalism and communication skills

## Optional

- [Ways to Solve a Problem of Idiomatic Translation](https://samploon.com/ways-to-solve-a-problem-of-idiomatic-translation): Essay on translation strategies for idioms using Mona Baker's approach
- [Beach as a Location for Vacation](https://samploon.com/beach-as-a-location-for-vacation): Argumentative essay comparing beach vs mountain vacation destinations
- [How to Play a Soccer?](https://samploon.com/how-to-play-a-soccer): Beginner's guide to soccer basics, skills, and training techniques
